title: Engulfing
caption:
One candle that swallows the last one whole.

A small red candle, then a big green one that covers it: bullish engulfing, buyers took over. Flip it, and it's bearish engulfing.

They mean most after a long move, and on heavy volume. But no candle is a guarantee on its own.

Practise spotting them at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

narration: One candle that swallows the last one whole. A small red candle, then a big green one whose body completely covers it. That's a bullish engulfing. Buyers have taken over. Flip it, and a small green candle followed by a big red one is a bearish engulfing. Sellers have taken over. They mean most after a long move, and on heavy volume. But no candle is a guarantee on its own. Practise spotting them at memestreet.net.
